hotels.title: Vibrant Downtown Tempe Escape with Rooftop Pool & Four Restaurant & Bars
hotels.description: Experience the vibrant energy of Arizona with a stay at this stylish and beautifully designed hotel, perfectly positioned in the heart of Tempe. Offering easy access to the Arizona State University campus, the eclectic Mill Avenue for shopping and dining, and the Tempe Town Lake for scenic strolls, it couldn't be better located for days spent exploring this revitalised town. Indulge in authentic American cuisine at Neighbourhood Services restaurant, or refresh yourself with a dip in the rooftop pool, complete with private cabanas and poolside loungers. Start each day at Library Rules, where you'll find specialty coffee and pastries, before embarking on a daily adventure - both the breathtaking Papago Park and Desert Botanical Garden are just a short drive away.

hotels.title: Arizona Escape with Rooftop Bar, Daily US$40 Dining Credit & Nightly Cocktails
hotels.description: Rising as a contemporary icon in the Arizona desert, The Westin Tempe redefines the desert retreat with a seamless blend of modern sophistication and holistic well-being. Building upon the energy of Mill Avenue and Arizona State University, you're steps from Tempe's best dining and entertainment, and the vibrant pule of the nearby Mill Avenue district, making for the perfect weekend away. Before stepping out, ascend to Skysill Rooftop Lounge, the Valley’s highest open-air destination, to sip artisanal cocktails against a backdrop of panoramic mountain sunsets. When hunger strikes, Terra Tempe Kitchen & Spirits serves up bold Southwestern-inspired cuisine with handcrafted cocktails and locally sourced ingredients just downstairs. Your US$40 daily dining credit keeps things flexible, whether you're grabbing a cold brew on your way out or settling in for the evening at Terra. The Westin Tempe is where downtown energy meets an elevated, tranquil escape.
